verdict.rationale: Google's documentation confirms Titan ships in both USB-A/NFC and USB-C/NFC models, so the port half of the story is covered. Nothing in the evidence shows a low-profile nano form factor or explicitly describes keychain design, and one community comment calls the key big. missing for 10: low-profile nano form factor, documented keychain/carry design, independent hands-on corroboration of the form-factor lineup.

support.subject: As a power user, the lineup covers my ports and carry style — USB-C and USB-A models, keychain and low-profile nano form factors

citations.quote: Titan Security Keys are available in two form factors: USB-A/NFC and USB-C/NFC.
